test_purposes.LHM-16403-TITLE-VISUAL: Verify the title and logo are visible, emphasized, non-overlapping, and within design-compatible size ranges without requiring exact Gold CSS constants.
test_purposes.LHM-16403-CAPTION-CONTENT: Verify the redundant aggregate caption is absent while every bundle still exposes its name, size, and share.
test_purposes.LHM-16403-CAPTION-HIERARCHY: Verify bundle names and metrics remain readable and receive distinct visual emphasis without requiring a particular element count or margin.
test_purposes.LHM-16403-COLOR-FAMILIES: Verify every top-level bundle receives a distinct computed color and its text meets a deterministic contrast requirement.
test_purposes.LHM-16403-DEPTH-COLOR: Verify descendants differ visibly from parents while remaining in the same color family.
test_purposes.LHM-16403-SELECTION-DETAILS: Verify choosing a bundle continues to expose the selected bundle name, byte total, and percentage.
test_purposes.LHM-16403-HEADER-TOTAL: Verify choosing a bundle does not replace the report-wide byte total in the header.
test_purposes.LHM-16403-TABLE-P2P: Verify the existing resource table remains populated and semantically complete without requiring row order or exact DOM tags.
